div.head: Af El. 49
div.ab: Ðis sindon ða domas ðe se ælmihtiga God sylf sprecende wæs to Moyse ond him bebead to healdenne; ond siððan se acenneda Godes sunu, ðæt is hælende Crist, on woruld becom, he cwæð, þæt he ne come no þas (word uel) bebodu to brecanne ne to forbeodanne, ac mid eallum godum to geecenne; ond mildheortnesse ond eaðmodnesse he lærde.

Þis sindan ða domas þe se ælmihtega God self sprecende wæs to Moyse ⁊ him bebead to healdanne; ⁊ siððan se áncenneda Dryhtnes sunu, ure God, þæt is hælend Crist, on middangeard cwom, he cwæð, ðæt he ne come no ðas bebodu to brecanne ne to forbeodanne, ac mid eallum godum to ecanne; ⁊ mildheortnesse ⁊ eaðmodnesse he lærde.

Hæc sunt iudicia quæ Dominus ipse locutus est ad Moysen et precepit ei custodire. Et postquam natus pro salute nostra Dei filius, dominus et saluator noster Jesus Christus, uenit in mundum, ait: ‘Non ueni legem soluere sed adimplere’, pietate scilicet et misericordia.

Þis sindan ða domas þe se ælmihtega God self sprecende wæs to Moyse ⁊ him bebead to healdanne; ⁊ siððan se áncenneda Dryhtnes sunu, ure God, þæt is hælend Crist, on middangeard cwom, he cwæð, ðæt he ne come no ðas bebodu to brecanne ne to forbeodanne, ac mid eallum godum to ecanne; ⁊ mildheortnesse ⁊ eaðmodnesse he lærde.

These are the judgments that almighty God was speaking himself to Moses and bade him keep; and after the only begotten son of the Lord our God, that is the savior Christ, came into the world, he declared, that he did not come in any way to break or forbid these commandments, but rather to increase them with all good [laws]; and he taught mercy and humility.

Dies [Obige] sind die Gebote, welche der allmächtige Gott selbst zu Moses sprach und ihm gebot zu halten. Und als der eingeborene Sohn des Herrn, unser Gott, das ist Heiland Christus, zur Erde kam, sagte er, dass er nicht gekommen sei, diese Gebote zu brechen oder zu verbieten, sondern mit allem Guten zu vermehren: und Barmherzigkeit und Demuth lehrte er.

These [above] are the commandments which almighty God himself spoke to Moses and commanded him to keep. And when the only-begotten Son of the Lord, our God, that is Christ the Saviour, came to earth, he said that he had not come to break these commandments or to forbid them, but to increase them with all good things: and he taught mercy and humility.
